How far the pointer moved up or down since the last call. See [MouseXSpeed](MouseXSpeed).
@param canvas  BlitzPlus only: a canvas handle, to get the vertical movement relative to that canvas. Defaults to 0, which is the graphics buffer.
@param device  Only look at this mouse, counted from 0 as in MouseDeviceCount. -1 (the default) means all mice together. With a device, the movement is that of a pointer that only this mouse moves; it starts in the middle of the buffer and stays inside it.
@returns The change of the vertical position since the previous call.
@gap The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.
